description: GasTranSim.jl implements an explicit staggered-grid method for transient gas flow through pipeline networks. Its registered Julia package includes examples, tests and JSON data schemas with a validator. The provider is Kaarthik Sundar and collaborators. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The repository identifies an MIT licence. Numerical behaviour and package installation were not tested. Limitations: The metadata describe the authors’ work; they do not independently establish accuracy, completeness or reproducibility. For simulation it provides time-dependent gas-network flow calculations from network and boundary inputs. Related resources: model-gasmodels-jl is an existing gas-network optimisation package. GasTranSim supplies a distinct transient forward solver.
